label: There is a Kripke model with at least one world, a symmetric frame and a positivity assignment on…
meaning: Nonvacuous satisfiability of Scott's T3 premises: unlike premisesJointlySatisfiable in SCOTT-GOD-LIKE-NECESSARILY-EXISTS, whose frozen type an empty type of worlds satisfies vacuously, this type requires a world, so it is the consistency check that contrasts with GOEDEL-1970-INCONSISTENT. Formal satisfiability inside the Lean embedding of QML KB only.
